subject: Pilot evaluation exchange: MAP, dataset delivery & usage constraints
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@retailco.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: eval dataset exchange & MAP request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the team is excited to move forward with a short pilot. To keep momentum we want to exchange a small evaluation corpus and a prompt pack so your models can run against our storefront examples.

Can you send a proposed mutual action plan (high-level milestones + ownership) and a short list of constraints we need to agree on for the dataset (retention, logging, permitted uses, destruction)? We anticipate legal + procurement will need those items to sign off.

Planned pilot window: early January, two weeks. Deliverables we expect from Redwood by kickoff:
- A sandbox-ready model endpoint and API key
- Test prompt pack with example queries and expected acceptance criteria
- MAP with milestones and target close date for production decision

We will deliver the evaluation dataset (approx. 3k anonymized queries and session traces) and an internal acceptance rubric. We prefer limited-retention access and data destruction at the end of the pilot.

If you can share the MAP and sample prompt pack today or tomorrow we can route through procurement for a quick review.

Best,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of ML Partnerships | RetailCo
Marta.lopez@retailco.com

Attachments: none in this message
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@retailco.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: eval dataset exchange & MAP request

Marta — thanks, and happy to get this moving while the team is available. High-level MAP and constraints attached; quick summary below.

Summary (draft MAP)
• Milestone 1 (Dec 27): Exchange of MAP workbook and prompt pack sample — ACTION: Redwood (Jordan) to deliver MAP_RetailCo_v1.xlsx and promptpack_sample.zip (attached).
• Milestone 2 (Jan 4): Endpoint provisioning and scoped API key for RetailCo sandbox — ACTION: Redwood infra (Ben) to provision with ephemeral tokens and logging hooks.
• Milestone 3 (Jan 6): Pilot kickoff (run tests Jan 6–19). RetailCo runs acceptance rubric and shares top-10 failure modes.
• Milestone 4 (Jan 20): Production decision meeting; Redwood to provide cost/perf guidance for dedicated capacity if accepted.

Key dataset usage constraints (draft)
• Retention: Redwood will retain dataset material for 90 days post-pilot unless otherwise agreed; auto-delete schedule to be configured.
• Logging: Request-level logs retained for debugging only; redacted before long-term storage.
• Allowed uses: Evaluation + model tuning in sandbox only; no sharing with third parties.
• Security: Data encrypted in transit and at rest; customer-supplied KMS available for Private deployments.

Attached: MAP_RetailCo_v1.xlsx (workbook with milestones), promptpack_sample.zip (sample prompts + expected outputs). I also added a short acceptance checklist inside the MAP.

If procurement wants a one-page summary for legal, point them to the MAP file; happy to jump on a 20-min call this afternoon if that helps.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_RetailCo_v1.xlsx (xlsx), promptpack_sample.zip (zip)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot: eval dataset exchange & MAP request

Looping in a couple of operational redlines we should surface proactively to RetailCo and include as footnotes in the MAP. Quoting Jordan's note below for context.

On Thu, 24 Dec 2026 at 11:00 AM Jordan Blake wrote:
> Summary (draft MAP)
> • Milestone 1 (Dec 27): Exchange of MAP workbook and prompt pack sample — ACTION: Redwood (Jordan) to deliver MAP_RetailCo_v1.xlsx and promptpack_sample.zip (attached).
> • ...

Operational redlines (proposed)
- Retention: we can support 90 days default but procurement often asks for firm deletions. Recommend we offer: 90-day default OR customer-managed deletion request via support ticket with audit trail.
- Access tokens: sandbox keys must be ephemeral (max TTL 30 days) and scope-limited to the sandbox project. No long-term production keys in evaluation mode.
- Derivative models: explicitly prohibit training Redwood public models on raw RetailCo evaluation data; allow local tuning in an isolated sandbox instance if customer requires.
- Watermarking/forensics: we can add basic response watermarking to generated outputs for traceability if RetailCo prefers.

I'll draft redlines and return a redlined doc (redlines_RET-7892.docx). Laura, can you confirm the SLA language and whether we need a custodian signature for deletion?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: redlines_RET-7892.docx
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@retailco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: eval dataset exchange & MAP request

Jordan / Ben / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround and the draft MAP. Procurement reviewed the constraints and we can agree to the set below with one clarification on retention.

Accepted items
• 90-day default retention with a customer-managed deletion request (audit trail) — confirmed.
• Ephemeral sandbox tokens (30-day TTL) and scope restrictions — confirmed.
• No training of Redwood public models on raw dataset; isolated tuning only in an access-controlled sandbox — confirmed.
• Watermarking on generated outputs is acceptable as an extra traceability layer.

Clarification: For the deletion request, procurement needs the deletion ticket owner and a maximum SLA (we propose 5 business days to complete deletion + confirmation). If Redwood can commit to a 5 business-day deletion SLA and provide the ticket/audit URL in the MAP, procurement will sign off on the MAP and we can proceed with dataset delivery.

Next steps and timeline
• Jordan to update MAP with deletion SLA and ticketing URL by EOD Dec 28.
• RetailCo will deliver the anonymized eval corpus (3k rows) via secure transfer on Jan 3.
• Redwood to provision sandbox endpoint and scoped API key by Jan 4.
• Pilot runs Jan 6–19.
• Production decision call Jan 20 (15m).

Please send the updated MAP and a DocuSign summary for procurement. If you can include the ticketing URL (or HubSpot task link) in the MAP we can close procurement this week.

Happy holidays — speak Monday if anything pops up.

Best,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of ML Partnerships | RetailCo
Marta.lopez@retailco.com
